# American Medical Association (AMA)

> > The American Medical Association is the premier national organization providing medical ethics guidance, CPT coding standards, physician advocacy, and professional resources for physicians and medical students.

The AMA serves as the authoritative source for the Code of Medical Ethics, develops and maintains the Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) coding system, and advocates for physicians on healthcare policy issues including Medicare payment reform, physician wellbeing, and the Dr. Lorna Breen law. The organization supports medical professionals throughout their careers with resources like the FREIDA Residency Database, AMA Ed Hub for CME education, and the Physicians Grassroots Network for advocacy.

## Key Topics

- Code of Medical Ethics
- CPT (Current Procedural Terminology) coding
- Physician wellbeing and burnout prevention
- Medical student residency preparation
- Medicare and MACRA payment programs
- Informed consent requirements
- Healthcare advocacy and policy
- HIPAA compliance
- AMA Ed Hub CME education
- FREIDA Residency Database
- Dr. Lorna Breen law
- Physicians Grassroots Network
- Improving Health Outcomes initiative
- Clinical ethics guidance
- Physician professional satisfaction

## Medical Ethics & Code of Conduct

- [Code of Medical Ethics: Preface & Preamble](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/code-medical-ethics-preface-preamble): Introduction to AMA Code of Medical Ethics and physician responsibilities
- [Confidential Health Care for Minors](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/confidential-health-care-minors): Ethics guidance on minor patient confidentiality and parental consent
- [Routine Universal Immunization of Physicians](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/routine-universal-immunization-physicians): AMA ethics opinion on physician vaccination responsibilities
- [Reporting Clinical Test Results](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/reporting-clinical-test-results): Ethics guidance on timely communication of test results to patients
- [Collaborative Care](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/collaborative-care): Ethics guidance on team-based care and physician leadership roles
- [Routine Universal Screening for HIV](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/routine-universal-screening-hiv): AMA ethics opinion on routine HIV screening and informed consent
- [Physician Participation in Interrogation](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/physician-participation-interrogation): AMA ethics guidance on physician roles in interrogations and detainee care
- [Umbilical Cord Blood Banking](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/umbilical-cord-blood-banking): Ethics guidance on cord blood donation and storage options for patients
- [Release of Data from Unethical Experiments](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/ethics/release-data-unethical-experiments): Ethics guidance on publishing data from unethical research experiments

## Physician Wellbeing & Professional Satisfaction

- [Physician Professional Satisfaction](https://www.ama-assn.org/practice-management/physician-health/physician-professional-satisfaction): AMA initiatives to improve physician satisfaction and reduce burnout
- [Physician Wellness Program](https://www.ama-assn.org/membership/benefits-discounts/physician-wellness-program): Complimentary wellness program for AMA group practice members

## CPT Coding & Practice Management

- [The Purpose of the CPT Coding System & the CPT Editorial Panel](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/cpt-editorial-panel/purpose-cpt-coding-system-cpt-editorial-panel): Overview of CPT coding system purpose and Editorial Panel governance
- [MACRA Acronyms Explained](https://www.ama-assn.org/practice-management/medicare-medicaid/macra-acronyms-explained): Glossary of MACRA and Medicare quality payment program terminology

## Medical Education & Training

- [Scheduling Clinical Clerkships and Rotations](https://www.ama-assn.org/medical-students/clinical-rotations/scheduling-clinical-clerkships-and-rotations): Guide for medical students on scheduling clerkships and clinical rotations
- [Guidelines for Establishing an Observership for International Medical Graduates](https://www.ama-assn.org/member-groups-sections/international-medical-graduates-section-imgs/guidelines-establishing): Guidelines for creating IMG observership programs with ECFMG standards

## Healthcare Advocacy & Policy

- [Why We Fight: Reforming Medicare Payment](https://www.ama-assn.org/amaone/why-we-fight-reforming-medicare-payment): AMA advocacy efforts for Medicare payment reform and physician compensation
- [What African Americans with Diabetes or Hypertension Need to Know](https://www.ama-assn.org/public-health/population-health/what-african-americans-diabetes-or-hypertension-need-know): Patient education on kidney disease screening for African Americans

## Member Partnerships & Benefits

- [Privia Health Physicians](https://www.ama-assn.org/amaone/privia-health-physicians): AMA partnership with Privia Health offering member benefits and advocacy
- [Northwell Health Physicians](https://www.ama-assn.org/amaone/northwell-health-physicians): AMA partnership with Northwell Health for sponsored membership benefits

## Optional

- [Telescoping 50 Years: Smoking Report Anniversary](https://www.ama-assn.org/about/leadership/telescoping-50-years-smoking-report-anniversary-makes-us-look-back-and-ahead): Reflection on 50th anniversary of Surgeon General's smoking report
